text: Understand the features and use of different types of physical computers
Understand the features and use of different types of hardware devices
points: processors — number of cores, clock speed, cache size, mobile processors
Main memory — RAM (Random Access Memory), ROM (Read-only Memory)
secondary storage: — magnetic, solid state, optical
network interface devices: — PCI (Peripheral Component Interconnect), USB (Universal Serial Bus)

text: Understand the features and use of operating systems
points: batch: — non-interactive applications, high volume, scheduling
multitasking: — concurrent execution of multiple tasks, time-slicing, interrupts
real-time operating system: — monitoring and control applications, transaction processing
network operating system: — resource sharing, user management, communication
mobile operating system: — smartphones and tablets, lower processing requirements, increased battery life

text: Understand the features and use of common utilities
Understand the features and use of common code development tools
points: integrated development environments: — code editing tools, debugging tools, screen design tools

text: Understand the features and use of common application software
Understand the benefits and drawbacks of connecting devices to form networks.
Understand the features of different types of networks
points: network types: — personal area network (PAN), local area network (LAN), metropolitan area network (MAN), wide area network (WAN), virtual private network (VPN)

text: Understand the features, characteristics, benefits and drawbacks of connectivity methods
Understand the features, benefits and drawbacks of the common network topologies
Understand the features, benefits and drawbacks of different network models
Understand the role of common components of a network
Understand the seven-layer OSI (open systems interconnection) model, including the function and related protocols of each layer
Understand the four-layer TCP/IP (transmission control protocol/ internet protocol) model, including the function and related protocols of each layer
Understand the role of data packets in transmitting over a network, including
points: contents and structure of a data packet
role of the components of a data packet
packet switching: — causes of packet loss

text: Understand the role of common network protocols
points: application protocols: — FTP, SFTP, DHCP, DNS

text: Understand the concepts of bandwidth and latency, and their effect on the performance of networks and connected systems.
Understand the role and characteristics of common virtual environment components
points: virtual machines: — clients (virtual PC, virtual switch, virtual router), servers

text: Understand the key features of virtual environments
Understand the benefits of the use of virtual environments
points: provision of education and training options

text: Understand the drawbacks of the use of virtual environments
points: potential for false representation of performance

text: Understand different types of cloud
Understand the benefits of the use of cloud
Understand common cloud delivery models, their advantages and disadvantages, and the way in which responsibility and ownership of resources are distributed between the client and the cloud provider
points: Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS): — client manages application software, system software (middleware and operating system), runtime, data and user accounts, cloud provider manages virtualisation and hardware (servers, network and storage)

Platform as a Service (PaaS): — client manages application software, data and user accounts, cloud provider manages virtualisation, hardware (servers, network and storage) and systems software (middleware and operating system) and runtime

Software as a Service (SaaS): — client manages user accounts and data, cloud provider manages virtualisation, hardware (servers, network and storage) systems software (middleware and operating system), runtime and application software

text: Understand the benefits of resilient environments and the impact on organisations and clients
points: increased security: — data security (storage and transfer), reduced vulnerabilities
increased reputation: — protect brand/image, retain customer confidence

text: Understand methods used to improve the resilience of digital environments
points: software updates/upgrades: — planned updates/upgrades, patches in response to new vulnerabilities
hardware replacement: — rolling replacement plans, secure disposal
device hardening: — removal of unneeded ports, applications, permissions and access
backup systems and recovery procedures: — onsite, remote/offsite, cloud
standard operating procedures: — effective staff training, induction, new digital systems, new or updated policies
